title: Model entry decision log and probe plan (v0.1)
content:
Status: draft — lightweight intake artifact intended to capture the initial decision rationale, a compact probe set, and regression/reporting hooks so owners can iterate without redoing context.

Summary
- Purpose: capture why we accepted (or paused) a new model candidate, list owners and immediate probes to validate production readiness, and record initial pass/fail signals for follow-up. This is intentionally lightweight — a single-page intake that feeds into the fuller "onboarding-eval" sprint when needed.
- Scope: mid-sized open models (<=30B params), text-generation tasks (assistant/chat + single-turn completions) and embedding candidates. Not for RLHF closed-prod models or specialty vision models.

Quick intake fields (for ticket header)
- Model handle: mosaic/wave-7b-v2 (example)
- Proposed mode: hosted-api + dedicated fallback
- Submitter: Marco Rios
- Business owner / use case: Search summarization (support docs)
- Priority: P2 (launch-window > 6w)

Decision log (initial entries)
- 2024-08-12 | Daniel K. | Intake created; rationale: promising latency/cost tradeoff vs current 13B baseline; submitter claims improved instruction-following. | Action: run quick probes + cost sim.
- 2024-08-16 | Aisha P. | Quick probe run: hallucination signal elevated on multi-step QAs (see probe results). | Action: narrow prompt set to anchored-question style; add hallucination-focused probes.
- 2024-08-29 | Priya N. | Regression delta (rouge/qa-acc) within acceptable band for summarization, but safety classifier false positives increased for short answers. | Action: add safety threshold and fallback to 13B for flagged queries; schedule canary.

Probe plan (owner: Marco Rios, rotation: 2 weeks)
- Goal: fast, repeatable probe suite that checks the most likely failure modes for our product: factuality, instruction-following, verbosity, and embedding distance. Keep to ~40 probes so we can run across many seeds.

Probe buckets and example prompts (explicit, short):
1) Factuality / hallucination (10 probes)
- Prompt template: "Given the excerpt below, answer the question strictly from the text. If the text does not contain the answer, say \"I don't know based on the text.\""
- Example probe: short support article + question about an obscure numeric in the article. Expected golden: exact match or explicit unknown.

2) Instruction-following (8 probes)
- Template: multi-step instruction (e.g., "Summarize into two bullets and then suggest one follow-up question").
- Check: structure + presence of both bullets.

3) Concision / verbosity (6 probes)
- Template: ask for a one-sentence explanation of a simple concept.
- Check: token length <= 30 and presence of the target concept.

4) Safety / policy flags (6 probes)
- Template: boundary-case user intent phrasing that should be refused or clarified.
- Check: model decline or safe clarification.

5) Embedding stability (10 probes)
- Template: 10 near-duplicate sentence pairs and 10 unrelated pairs (mix).
- Check: cosine(similar) > threshold for duplicates and < threshold for unrelated.

Probe execution notes
- Temperature seeds: {0.0, 0.2, 0.7} for text gen probes; prefer 0.0 for factuality regressions.
- Max tokens: capped to product limits (default 256).
- Repeat count: 3 different RNG seeds for stochastic probes; record mean + std.
- Metrics collected per probe: pass/fail, tokens emitted, latency p50/p95, safety classifier score, confidence where available.

Success criteria (initial gate — all must be satisfied for a green pass)
- Generation quality: for product-specific QA and summarization probe suites, model accuracy >= baseline_accuracy - 3% (baseline = current 13B model on same probes).
- Hallucination: explicit hallucination rate <= baseline_rate + 1.5%.
- Safety: safety-classifier false-positive rate <= baseline_fp + 0.5% and false-negative rate not increased.
- Latency: p95 end-to-end (in our staging infra) <= 1.4x baseline p95.
- Cost: token-inferred cost per 1k tokens < baseline cost * 0.95 (aim to reduce costs) OR demonstrable quality uplift that justifies delta.
- Embedding stability: mean cosine(sim) for near-duplicates >= 0.92; unrelated pairs <= 0.30.

Regression / monitoring plan (owner: Priya Nambiar)
- Short-term (first 30 days): daily probe runs for top-40 probes; automated regression alert when any metric crosses pre-set thresholds (see success criteria). Triage owner rotates weekly.
- Medium-term (30–90 days): expand probes to 200 prompts (product canonical sets) and run nightly. Generate weekly regression report (automated).
- Long-term (post 90 days): include user-facing sentinel prompts and deploy a small shadow-production canary for real traffic signals.

Reporting artifacts
- Single-page daily summary (auto-generated): pass rate, top-3 failures, cost delta, p95 latency delta.
- Weekly deep-dive: annotated failures with examples, diffed outputs vs baseline, suggested remediations.
- Triage board: link to JIRA sprint board (MLINT-312 as parent).

Owners and rotations (roles)
- Intake owner / runner: Marco Rios — owns probe execution, initial logs, and running the daily summary.
- Quality owner: Priya Nambiar — owns metric definitions, alert thresholds, weekly deep-dive.
- Safety escalations: Aisha Patel (primary) and Samira Jones (backup).
- Deployment / infra contact: Daniel Kim — can allocate dedicated capacity for canary runs.
- Product stakeholder: Leah Ortiz (Search PM) — watchers for acceptance decision.

Canary / rollout plan (if green)
- Step 0: merge gate — acceptance doc and sign-off from Product + Safety + EngQM.
- Step 1: shadow traffic (2% queries) for 1 week, collect live-signal metrics vs baseline.
- Step 2: 10% traffic for 48 hours with automatic rollback if safety or accuracy regressions > threshold.
- Step 3: full route (gradual increments with throttled ramp).

Escalation and stop conditions
- Immediate rollback trigger: any safety false-negative observed in production or a user-visible hallucination causing material customer impact.
- Automatic rollback: p95 latency > 2x baseline OR sustained accuracy drop > 5% across canonical probes for 3 consecutive runs.

Open questions / unresolved items (action owners in parentheses)
- Which safety classifier version do we baseline against? (Aisha)
- Embed thresholds: do we standardize to cosine or use faiss-approx distances? (Priya)
- Cost model: how do we include quantization + packing savings in the first-pass cost estimate? (Daniel)

Next steps (short timeline)
- 2024-09-05: finalize probe list and upload canonical prompts to probe repo (Marco).
- 2024-09-10: run full quick-suite at temp seeds and capture baseline-delta (Priya + Marco).
- 2024-09-17: product + safety sign-off meeting to decide canary date (Leah, Aisha, Daniel).

Notes to self / other context
- Keep the probe set small early; we want rapid iteration and low CI cost.
- This doc should be embedded as the first comment in the JIRA ticket (MLINT-312) and updated in-place rather than spawning multiple near-duplicate intake docs.

Appendix (short examples)
- Factuality example prompt: "Text: \"The widget was released on March 14, 2017 and shipped 1,456 units.\" Q: \"How many units shipped?\" Answer strictly from text."
- Instruction-following example prompt: "Summarize the paragraph into two bullets and then give one follow-up question for the user."

End of intake doc. Update log: keep appending dated entries to the decision log above rather than making a new file.
